message.content:
In the conversation, WolfgangSchulz invites LiHua over to watch a movie at his place. During their discussion about snacks, LiHua agrees to bring some chips. This decision is made clear in the following exchange:

> LiHua: For sure! I can bring some chips! What drinks do you want? 🥤
>
> WolfgangSchulz: Awesome! Just some soda and juice will be perfect. Can't wait for the movie night! 🚀🎥

Therefore, the snack that LiHua agrees to bring for the movie is chips.
